meta.conventions: world X,Y horizontal, Z up, right-handed; positions minus origin, times minus t0; eta = sum a cos(k(X cos th + Y sin th) - w t + phi) with the rebased phi; z = CG height above calm water; pitch = total trim, > 0 bow down; R = Rz(yaw) Ry(pitch) Rx(roll); a_cg, a_bow = vertical acceleration (kinematic, m/s^2: -g in free fall)

hull.name: scarab195
hull.note: body frame from the CG: x forward, y left, z up; stations transom to stem; section = keel (0, zk), chine (+-yc, zk + min(yc tan(beta), depth)), deck edge (+-yc, zk + depth) -- the plant's prismatic hull; x_fine / yc_fine / zk_fine: the chine and keel from hydro/hull_geometry at points chosen so that the polyline is within line_tol (m) of them everywhere, denser where they bend (the stem); x_tab / yc_tab: the same for the chine with at most 64 points, within tab_tol (draw from these, never from taper / stem_rise)
